question: Collect papers showing braid phase calibration methods that reduce timing drift in cooperative drone swarms.
expected_answer_points: anchor calibration reduces timing drift in cooperative drone swarms
handshake calibration reduces timing drift in cooperative drone swarms
echo calibration reduces timing drift in cooperative drone swarms

candidate_papers.title: Anchor braid phase calibration for cooperative drone swarms
candidate_papers.text: Anchor braid phase calibration reduces timing drift in cooperative drone swarms by pinning each drone clock to a shared phase marker before formation changes.

candidate_papers.title: Handshake calibration for braid phase drone timing
candidate_papers.text: Handshake braid phase calibration reduces cooperative drone swarm timing drift by exchanging paired timing beacons at the start of each route segment.

candidate_papers.title: Echo braid phase calibration in swarm timing control
candidate_papers.text: Echo braid phase calibration reduces timing drift in cooperative drone swarms by replaying a short reference pulse after each maneuver.

candidate_papers.title: Braid phase collision avoidance without timing calibration
candidate_papers.text: This conflicting citation studies cooperative drone swarms and braid phase control but reports that timing calibration did not reduce drift in collision trials.

candidate_papers.title: Review of drone swarm phase coordination
candidate_papers.text: This close review repeats braid phase, calibration, timing drift, and cooperative drone swarm terms, but it cites background coordination work without measuring drift reduction.
